movie_title: What Happens If You Destroy A Black Hole?
introduction: Go ‘beyond the nutshell’ at https://brilliant.org/nutshell/ and dive deeper into these topics and mo

vocabulary.definition: to destroy completely; to reduce to nonexistence
vocabulary.example: When matter and antimatter collide, they annihilate each other, releasing a tremendous amount of energy.

vocabulary.definition: the act of giving more food or substance than necessary
vocabulary.example: The overfeeding of the black hole with excessive charge led to unexpected consequences.

vocabulary.definition: a point at which a function takes an infinite value, especially in space-time when matter is infinitely dense, like in a black hole
vocabulary.example: The concept of a singularity at the center of a black hole challenges our understanding of physics.

vocabulary.definition: to change from a liquid or solid state into vapor; to disappear gradually
vocabulary.example: Over time, the black hole will emit Hawking radiation and slowly evaporate.

vocabulary.definition: limitless or endless in space, extent, or size; impossible to measure or calculate
vocabulary.example: The gravitational pull of a black hole creates an infinite curvature in space-time.

vocabulary.definition: the process of invalidating or making void; the act of bringing something to an end
vocabulary.example: When the charges of the black hole and anti black hole cancel out, they merge into a single entity.
